request: Zeig mir mein Gehalt von Mustermann Systems Monat fuer Monat 2025 als Linie.

sql:

sql:
SELECT month_of_half, half,
       ROUND(SUM(total) OVER (PARTITION BY half ORDER BY month_of_half), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(((CAST(strftime('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) - 1) % 6) + 1 AS TEXT) AS month_of_half,

  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount > 0
  GROUP BY half, month_of_half
)
